<h2 style="text-align: center;"><span class="mds-title-xlarge">Watch out for the latest tech support and computer virus scams</span></h2>
<p> </p>
<p style="text-align: center;">Scammers pretend to be tech support from a well-known company. They either call, text or try to trick you into clicking on a link in an email, text or pop-up window, claiming there’s a problem with your computer like a virus or a billing issue. To fix it, you inadvertently give them remote access to your computer.</p>
<p> </p>
</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div><div class="WithSectionIdentifier__StyledSectionIdentifierDiv-sc-w1dr2r-0 hKRxwV w-100 h-100" data-testid="section-mapping" id="tech-support-text" tabindex="-1"><div data-feature="structured-text" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__PrimaryBackground-sc-o56u0b-2 fuhlfO bzLCuV"><div class="mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="StructuredText__ImagePosition-sc-g71ha1-7 ctwurL"></div></div></div><div class="mds-jc-center mds-pb-6 mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-col-12 mds-col-at-992-6"><div class="mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-col"><div class="StructuredText__TitleWrapper-sc-g71ha1-2 gOoBnv"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 gdoRDP"><h3><span class="mds-title-xlarge-heavier">How it can happen:</span></h3>
</div></div><div class="StructuredText__CrossPromoImagePadding-sc-g71ha1-6 kLzFFG"><div class="StructuredText__CrossPromoMediaInnerWrapper-sc-g71ha1-5 iYoLPP"><picture class="ImageWithSources__StyledPicture-sc-rc01gv-0 hIeuvF"><source srcSet="/content/dam/chase-ux/structured-text/personal/privacy-security/tech-support-scams.jpg" media=""/><img src="/content/dam/chase-ux/structured-text/personal/privacy-security/tech-support-scams.jpg" alt="" loading="eager" class="Image__Img-sc-qsmt06-0 hGVAqr mds-va-bottom w-100"/></picture></div></div></div></div></div><div class="mds-col-12 mds-col-at-992-6"><div class="mds-px-4 mds-px-at-768-5 mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="StructuredText__ColumnWithBorder-sc-g71ha1-0 dxHbJB mds-pl-5"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 gdoRDP"><p>I got a giant yellow “alert” that covered my computer screen, saying my computer had been hacked. My cursor was even moving on its own, so something definitely seemed wrong. Another alert appeared that looked legitimately from the same brand as my computer, telling me to call the tech support line.</p>
<p> </p>
<p>The man who answered was very professional and said they’d been seeing this attack happening a lot lately. He had me go to a website that had all sorts of cyber security information on it and click on a link. He said it would let him see my screen to gauge how bad the attack was. He had me sign into some unimportant websites like a movie site and my pet store. He said everything looked fine, but I should sign into my bank account to also check it. He said he couldn’t see my password as it showed up with just those dots in the password field. I told him there were no unusual transactions on my account, so he said it looked like it was all a false alarm and hung up.</p>
<p> </p>
<p>Little did I know, that when I gave him remote access to my computer, he was able to see everything I typed. The scammers later signed into my bank account and transferred thousands out.</p>
<p> </p>
<h4>Help protect yourself</h4>
<p> </p>
<p>Scammers know “virus alerts” immediately put computer users into a panic. <strong>Never click on virus alerts, even if they look like they come from your computer company or an anti-virus protection company.</strong> If you think your computer was impacted, talk to a reputable service provider.</p>
</div><div class="StructuredText__SectionPadding-sc-g71ha1-3 iRNkXm"></div></div></div><div class="mds-pr-0 mds-row mds-no-gutters"></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></section><section aria-labelledby="tab-Identity theft" aria-hidden="true"><div id="1" class="mds-d-none"><div class="HorizontalTab__TabPanelWrapper-sc-w4jzmm-2 kSazWq"><div><div class="WithSectionIdentifier__StyledSectionIdentifierDiv-sc-w1dr2r-0 hKRxwV w-100 h-100" data-testid="section-mapping" id="identity-theft-text" tabindex="-1"><div data-feature="basic-text" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__NeutralBackground-sc-o56u0b-4 fuhlfO ddsMYX Background__BackgroundWithBorderRadius-sc-o56u0b-0"><div class="BasicText__MainContainer-sc-t3agr1-1 knhfJf mds-jc-center mds-no-gutters mds-row"><div class="mds-text-break mds-col mds-col-at-768-10 mds-px-4 mds-px-at-768-0"><div class="BasicText__DropCap-sc-t3agr1-0"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 boMkaX"><p> </p>
<h2 style="text-align: center;"><span class="mds-title-xlarge">Watch out for strangers trying to get your personal information</span></h2>
<p> </p>
<p style="text-align: center;">If a scammer gets hold of sensitive information such as your birth date, social security number, banking information or usernames and passwords, they can use it to steal your identity. Then pretending to be you, they could commit crimes, steal money from your bank accounts, open credit cards, take out loans or even rent an apartment in your name.</p>
<p> </p>
</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div><div class="WithSectionIdentifier__StyledSectionIdentifierDiv-sc-w1dr2r-0 hKRxwV w-100 h-100" data-testid="section-mapping" id="identity-theft-structured-text" tabindex="-1"><div data-feature="structured-text" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__PrimaryBackground-sc-o56u0b-2 fuhlfO bzLCuV"><div class="mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="StructuredText__ImagePosition-sc-g71ha1-7 ctwurL"></div></div></div><div class="mds-jc-center mds-pb-6 mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-col-12 mds-col-at-992-6"><div class="mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-col"><div class="StructuredText__TitleWrapper-sc-g71ha1-2 gOoBnv"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 gdoRDP"><h3><span class="mds-title-xlarge-heavier">How it can happen:</span></h3>
</div></div><div class="StructuredText__CrossPromoImagePadding-sc-g71ha1-6 kLzFFG"><div class="StructuredText__CrossPromoMediaInnerWrapper-sc-g71ha1-5 iYoLPP"><picture class="ImageWithSources__StyledPicture-sc-rc01gv-0 hIeuvF"><source srcSet="/content/dam/chase-ux/structured-text/personal/privacy-security/identity-theft-scams.jpg" media=""/><img src="/content/dam/chase-ux/structured-text/personal/privacy-security/identity-theft-scams.jpg" alt="" loading="eager" class="Image__Img-sc-qsmt06-0 hGVAqr mds-va-bottom w-100"/></picture></div></div></div></div></div><div class="mds-col-12 mds-col-at-992-6"><div class="mds-px-4 mds-px-at-768-5 mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="StructuredText__ColumnWithBorder-sc-g71ha1-0 dxHbJB mds-pl-5"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 gdoRDP"><p>I lost my wallet, which contained my social security number. Soon after, I began receiving strange letters from various banks and retailers, notifying me that I was approved for loans and credit cards. I hadn't applied for any of these. </p>
<p> </p>
<p>It became clear that someone had stolen my identity and was using it to open new lines of credit in my name.</p>
<p> </p>
<h4>Help protect yourself</h4>
<p>Identity theft can be devastating because it can take time to resolve, so think of your personal information as extremely valuable and guard it well.</p>
<ul>
<li><a rel="noopener" class="chaseanalytics-opt-doc-dnld regular-link" data-pt-name="privacy_pdf_kit" href="/content/dam/chase-ux/documents/digital/resources/identity-theft-kit.pdf" target="_blank">Download our free Identity Theft Kit (PDF)</a> to find out more about how to help protect yourself.</li>
<li>Never give your info to anyone who calls, texts or emails you.</li>
<li>Only carry the cards you use regularly and never carry your social security card.</li>
<li><a class="chaseanalytics-track-link regular-link" data-pt-name="privacy_lnk_alert" href="https://secure.chase.com/web/auth/nav?navKey=manageMyAlerts">Set up alerts</a> for your bank accounts.</li>
<li><a class="chaseanalytics-track-link regular-link" data-pt-name="privacy_lnk_score" href="/personal/credit-cards/free-credit-score">Enroll in Chase Credit Journey<sup>®</sup></a> to monitor your credit score and get notified of changes or new activity related to your identity.</li>
</ul>
</div><div class="StructuredText__SectionPadding-sc-g71ha1-3 iRNkXm"></div></div></div><div class="mds-pr-0 mds-row mds-no-gutters"></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></section><section aria-labelledby="tab-Investment scams" aria-hidden="true"><div id="2" class="mds-d-none"><div class="HorizontalTab__TabPanelWrapper-sc-w4jzmm-2 kSazWq"><div><div class="WithSectionIdentifier__StyledSectionIdentifierDiv-sc-w1dr2r-0 hKRxwV w-100 h-100" data-testid="section-mapping" id="cryptopigbutchering" tabindex="-1"><div data-feature="basic-text" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__NeutralBackground-sc-o56u0b-4 fuhlfO ddsMYX Background__BackgroundWithBorderRadius-sc-o56u0b-0"><div class="BasicText__MainContainer-sc-t3agr1-1 knhfJf mds-jc-center mds-no-gutters mds-row"><div class="mds-text-break mds-col mds-col-at-768-10 mds-px-4 mds-px-at-768-0"><div class="BasicText__DropCap-sc-t3agr1-0"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 boMkaX"><p> </p>
<h2 style="text-align: center;"><span class="mds-title-xlarge">Watch out for investment scams</span></h2>
<p> </p>
<p style="text-align: center;">Investment scams often happen over a period of time, with scammers waiting patiently until they gain your trust before recommending a great opportunity. They can even set up convincing-looking investment platforms that show big gains before they eventually disappear with your money.</p>
<p> </p>
</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div><div data-feature="structured-text" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__PrimaryBackground-sc-o56u0b-2 fuhlfO bzLCuV"><div class="mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="StructuredText__ImagePosition-sc-g71ha1-7 ctwurL"></div></div></div><div class="mds-jc-center mds-pb-6 mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-col-12 mds-col-at-992-6"><div class="mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-col"><div class="StructuredText__TitleWrapper-sc-g71ha1-2 gOoBnv"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 gdoRDP"><h3><span class="mds-title-xlarge-heavier">How it can happen:</span></h3>
</div></div><div class="StructuredText__CrossPromoImagePadding-sc-g71ha1-6 kLzFFG"><div class="StructuredText__CrossPromoMediaInnerWrapper-sc-g71ha1-5 iYoLPP"><picture class="ImageWithSources__StyledPicture-sc-rc01gv-0 hIeuvF"><source srcSet="/content/dam/chase-ux/structured-text/personal/privacy-security/crypto-pig-butchering-scams.jpg" media=""/><img src="/content/dam/chase-ux/structured-text/personal/privacy-security/crypto-pig-butchering-scams.jpg" alt="" loading="eager" class="Image__Img-sc-qsmt06-0 hGVAqr mds-va-bottom w-100"/></picture></div></div></div></div></div><div class="mds-col-12 mds-col-at-992-6"><div class="mds-px-4 mds-px-at-768-5 mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="StructuredText__ColumnWithBorder-sc-g71ha1-0 dxHbJB mds-pl-5"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 gdoRDP"><h4><p><img src="/content/dam/unified-assets/illustration/chase-spot-illustrations/communication-chat-bubble/mds_ill_communication_chat_bubble_linear.svg" alt="a chat conversation on pig butchering"> <span class="mds-title-large-heavier">My “friend’s” investment tip looked like a golden opportunity</span></p>
</h4>
<p> </p>
<p>A guy friended me on social months ago. We had mutual friends from grad school. Talking crypto was our thing, but we also often spoke about our wives and kids. One day, he shared a screenshot of how much he’d made on crypto, so I checked out the website and downloaded the app. I watched it for weeks, seeing it grow and I thought it couldn’t hurt to start small.</p>
<p> </p>
<p>Over the next few weeks, my dashboard showed good gains, so I made several more deposits. Because it kept getting better, I ended up making an additional investment of $23K.</p>
<p> </p>
<p>Then suddenly, I wasn’t able to access to my account anymore. No one was returning my phone calls, not even my “friend.” There was nothing I could do because the cryptocurrency didn’t exist. It was all a scam.</p>
<p> </p>
<h4>I wish I'd known:</h4>
<ul>
<li>Investment scams can unfold slowly. Scammers build relationships over time before making a move.</li>
<li>Many scams start on social media, where you’re prone to trust someone if you have a mutual connection.</li>
<li>Websites and apps can be much more sophisticated than you might expect.</li>
<li>You can check out the background, including registration or license status, of those recommending or selling an investment at investor.gov.</li>
<li>Treat crypto, Zelle<sup>®</sup>, checks, wires, cashier’s checks, transfers and gift cards like cash. Once scammers get the money, you probably won’t get it back.</li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<h4>Additional tips:</h4>
<ul>
<li>Scammers are advertising on social media and social marketplaces. Whenever possible, shop through official websites and be cautious of deals that seem too good to be true before sending any money.</li>
<li>Scammers can make caller ID, emails and texts display as messages from your bank or other businesses. If you are ever unsure, end the conversation and reach out to the company directly through their official website.</li>
</ul>
</div><div class="StructuredText__SectionPadding-sc-g71ha1-3 iRNkXm"></div></div></div><div class="mds-pr-0 mds-row mds-no-gutters"></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></section><section aria-labelledby="tab-Artificial Intelligence scam" aria-hidden="true"><div id="3" class="mds-d-none"><div class="HorizontalTab__TabPanelWrapper-sc-w4jzmm-2 kSazWq"><div><div data-feature="basic-text" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__NeutralBackground-sc-o56u0b-4 fuhlfO ddsMYX Background__BackgroundWithBorderRadius-sc-o56u0b-0"><div class="BasicText__MainContainer-sc-t3agr1-1 knhfJf mds-jc-center mds-no-gutters mds-row"><div class="mds-text-break mds-col mds-col-at-768-10 mds-px-4 mds-px-at-768-0"><div class="BasicText__DropCap-sc-t3agr1-0"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 boMkaX"><p> </p>
<h2 style="text-align: center;"><span class="mds-title-xlarge">Not everything that sounds or looks real is real</span></h2>
<p> </p>
<p style="text-align: center;">Scammers can use AI to clone voices impersonating people, such as that of a loved one. They’ll call using that voice, pretending to be desperate for money to get out of trouble or danger. It's very convincing.</p>
<p> </p>
</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div><div class="WithSectionIdentifier__StyledSectionIdentifierDiv-sc-w1dr2r-0 hKRxwV w-100 h-100" data-testid="section-mapping" id="artificial-intelligence-text" tabindex="-1"><div data-feature="structured-text" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__PrimaryBackground-sc-o56u0b-2 fuhlfO bzLCuV"><div class="mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="StructuredText__ImagePosition-sc-g71ha1-7 ctwurL"></div></div></div><div class="mds-jc-center mds-pb-6 mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-col-12 mds-col-at-992-6"><div class="mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-col"><div class="StructuredText__TitleWrapper-sc-g71ha1-2 gOoBnv"></div><div class="StructuredText__CrossPromoImagePadding-sc-g71ha1-6 kLzFFG"><div class="StructuredText__CrossPromoMediaInnerWrapper-sc-g71ha1-5 iYoLPP"><picture class="ImageWithSources__StyledPicture-sc-rc01gv-0 hIeuvF"><source srcSet="/content/dam/chase-ux/structured-text/personal/privacy-security/artificial-intelligence.jpg" media=""/><img src="/content/dam/chase-ux/structured-text/personal/privacy-security/artificial-intelligence.jpg" alt="" loading="eager" class="Image__Img-sc-qsmt06-0 hGVAqr mds-va-bottom w-100"/></picture></div></div></div></div></div><div class="mds-col-12 mds-col-at-992-6"><div class="mds-px-4 mds-px-at-768-5 mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="StructuredText__ColumnWithBorder-sc-g71ha1-0 dxHbJB mds-pl-5"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 gdoRDP"><h3><img src="/content/dam/unified-assets/illustration/chase-spot-illustrations/communication-chat-bubble/mds_ill_communication_chat_bubble_linear.svg" alt="a chat on ai scams"> <span class="mds-title-large-heavier">I'm usually cautious when I answer the phone</span></h3>
<p> </p>
<p>It started with a panicked voice message in a text: “Dad, I’m in trouble. I’ve had an accident. I’m OK but I need help fast. Please don’t tell mom, I’ll get this sorted.”</p>
<p> </p>
<p>It sounded exactly like my daughter. Same tone. Same way she says “please” when she needs to borrow money.</p>
<p> </p>
<p>Then the messages came quickly. She’d hit someone’s car. There wasn’t a lot of damage, but they wanted to call the police. She didn’t want it on her record. The man wanted cash. “Can you transfer it for me? I’ll pay you back.”</p>
<p> </p>
<p>I was busy at work but I dropped everything. I wired $3,000. Then nothing. Radio silence. I rang her cell. “Dad, I’m at the grocery store. What are you talking about?”</p>
<p> </p>
<p>My stomach dropped. It hadn’t been her. It was an AI-generated clone of her voice.</p>
<p> </p>
<p>And since I’d wired the money, it was gone. I fully believed I was protecting my child.</p>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>I wish I’d known:</strong></p>
<p> </p>
<ul>
<li>With technology, today’s scams don’t look or feel like scams anymore. They twist love, loyalty and fear into a perfect trap.</li>
<li>If someone you know says they need money fast, be extra alert. Call them directly on a number you know is theirs.</li>
<li>For friends and family, set up a safe word and don’t share it online.<b></b></li>
</ul>
</div><div class="StructuredText__SectionPadding-sc-g71ha1-3 iRNkXm"></div></div></div><div class="mds-pr-0 mds-row mds-no-gutters"></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></section><section aria-labelledby="tab-Money mule scams" aria-hidden="true"><div id="4" class="mds-d-none"><div class="HorizontalTab__TabPanelWrapper-sc-w4jzmm-2 kSazWq"><div><div data-feature="basic-text" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__NeutralBackground-sc-o56u0b-4 fuhlfO ddsMYX Background__BackgroundWithBorderRadius-sc-o56u0b-0"><div class="BasicText__MainContainer-sc-t3agr1-1 knhfJf mds-jc-center mds-no-gutters mds-row"><div class="mds-text-break mds-col mds-col-at-768-10 mds-px-4 mds-px-at-768-0"><div class="BasicText__DropCap-sc-t3agr1-0"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 boMkaX"><p> </p>
<h2 style="text-align: center;"><span class="mds-title-xlarge">Watch out for fake job offers - otherwise known as money mule scams</span></h2>
<p> </p>
<p style="text-align: center;">While you may think terms like “money mule” or “money laundering” refer to the drug trade, scammers have brought this movement of illicit funds into the corporate world. Unsuspecting “mules” are now often jobseekers applying for what appear to be legitimate job postings from legitimate companies. At some point in the hiring process, the “mule” is asked to receive and transfer money, usually from compromised accounts or through fraudulent checks, keeping a portion for themselves as compensation.</p>
<p> </p>
</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div><div class="WithSectionIdentifier__StyledSectionIdentifierDiv-sc-w1dr2r-0 hKRxwV w-100 h-100" data-testid="section-mapping" id="money-mule-text" tabindex="-1"><div data-feature="structured-text" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__PrimaryBackground-sc-o56u0b-2 fuhlfO bzLCuV"><div class="mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="StructuredText__ImagePosition-sc-g71ha1-7 ctwurL"></div></div></div><div class="mds-jc-center mds-pb-6 mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-col-12 mds-col-at-992-6"><div class="mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-col"><div class="StructuredText__TitleWrapper-sc-g71ha1-2 gOoBnv"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 gdoRDP"><h3><span class="mds-title-xlarge-heavier">How it can happen:</span></h3>
</div></div><div class="StructuredText__CrossPromoImagePadding-sc-g71ha1-6 kLzFFG"><div class="StructuredText__CrossPromoMediaInnerWrapper-sc-g71ha1-5 iYoLPP"><picture class="ImageWithSources__StyledPicture-sc-rc01gv-0 hIeuvF"><source srcSet="/content/dam/chase-ux/structured-text/personal/privacy-security/money-mule-scams.jpg" media=""/><img src="/content/dam/chase-ux/structured-text/personal/privacy-security/money-mule-scams.jpg" alt="" loading="eager" class="Image__Img-sc-qsmt06-0 hGVAqr mds-va-bottom w-100"/></picture></div></div></div></div></div><div class="mds-col-12 mds-col-at-992-6"><div class="mds-px-4 mds-px-at-768-5 mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="StructuredText__ColumnWithBorder-sc-g71ha1-0 dxHbJB mds-pl-5"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 gdoRDP"><p>I found a job posting for a well-known company in my field on a major job site. Without giving it a second thought, I submitted the application and was contacted to do a video interview. It all went well, and I was offered the job with a nice signing bonus.</p>
<p> </p>
<p>Before I started, my manager emailed that HR had doubled the amount of my bonus by mistake. He instructed me to go ahead and deposit the bonus check and to just use Zelle<sup>®</sup> to send back the overpayment amount. I assumed it was an honest mistake and certainly wasn’t going to make waves with my new boss, so I deposited the check and set up three different Zelle<sup>®</sup> payments. Lucky for me, my bank flagged the Zelle<sup>®</sup> payments as being unusual and blocked them. It turns out the job listing, the job, the bonus, and the bonus check were all fake. </p>
<p> </p>
<h4>Help protect yourself</h4>
<p> </p>
<p>No honest potential employer will ever send you a check to deposit and then tell you to send part of the money back. Honest employers will also never ask you to pay to get a job. Anyone who does is a scammer. </p>
<p> </p>
<p>You can also look up the name of the company or hiring manager along with the word "scam" or "complaint" to see if there's any red flags. Remember that scammers are sophisticated and they know how to use technology, social media, and they even pay for ads to lure prospective victims.</p>
</div><div class="StructuredText__SectionPadding-sc-g71ha1-3 iRNkXm"></div></div></div><div class="mds-pr-0 mds-row mds-no-gutters"></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></section><section aria-labelledby="tab-Gift card scams" aria-hidden="true"><div id="5" class="mds-d-none"><div class="HorizontalTab__TabPanelWrapper-sc-w4jzmm-2 kSazWq"><div><div data-feature="basic-text" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__NeutralBackground-sc-o56u0b-4 fuhlfO ddsMYX Background__BackgroundWithBorderRadius-sc-o56u0b-0"><div class="BasicText__MainContainer-sc-t3agr1-1 knhfJf mds-jc-center mds-no-gutters mds-row"><div class="mds-text-break mds-col mds-col-at-768-10 mds-px-4 mds-px-at-768-0"><div class="BasicText__DropCap-sc-t3agr1-0"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 boMkaX"><p> </p>
<h2 style="text-align: center;"><span class="mds-title-xlarge">Gift cards are for gifts, not to pay someone</span></h2>
<p> </p>
<p style="text-align: center;">Scammers use fake ads on social media as well as fake websites and apps to trick people into buying gift cards and sharing the codes. Once codes are shared, the money vanishes.</p>
<p> </p>
</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div><div class="WithSectionIdentifier__StyledSectionIdentifierDiv-sc-w1dr2r-0 hKRxwV w-100 h-100" data-testid="section-mapping" id="gift-card-scams" tabindex="-1"><div data-feature="structured-text" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__PrimaryBackground-sc-o56u0b-2 fuhlfO bzLCuV"><div class="mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="StructuredText__ImagePosition-sc-g71ha1-7 ctwurL"></div></div></div><div class="mds-jc-center mds-pb-6 mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-col-12 mds-col-at-992-6"><div class="mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-col"><div class="StructuredText__TitleWrapper-sc-g71ha1-2 gOoBnv"></div><div class="StructuredText__CrossPromoImagePadding-sc-g71ha1-6 kLzFFG"><div class="StructuredText__CrossPromoMediaInnerWrapper-sc-g71ha1-5 iYoLPP"><picture class="ImageWithSources__StyledPicture-sc-rc01gv-0 hIeuvF"><source srcSet="/content/dam/chase-ux/structured-text/personal/privacy-security/gift-card-scam.png" media=""/><img src="/content/dam/chase-ux/structured-text/personal/privacy-security/gift-card-scam.png" alt="" loading="eager" class="Image__Img-sc-qsmt06-0 hGVAqr mds-va-bottom w-100"/></picture></div></div></div></div></div><div class="mds-col-12 mds-col-at-992-6"><div class="mds-px-4 mds-px-at-768-5 mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="StructuredText__ColumnWithBorder-sc-g71ha1-0 dxHbJB mds-pl-5"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 gdoRDP"><h3><img src="/content/dam/unified-assets/illustration/chase-spot-illustrations/communication-chat-bubble/mds_ill_communication_chat_bubble_linear.svg" alt="a chat on gift card scams"> <span class="mds-title-large-heavier">I had scored a really great deal</span></h3>
<p> </p>
<p>I’d gone down a rabbit hole of searching every ticket site. Then — finally — a big-name seller showed availability. The site looked like it always did. At checkout, my card wouldn’t go through. A message popped up: call this number to complete your booking.</p>
<p> </p>
<p>Strange. But I was happy to have found seats, so I called. The agent said their payment system had been down all day, but other people had used their credit card to buy gift cards, and that was working. I email my nieces gift cards all the time, as they’re easy to buy online. He told me he’d hold the tickets and gave me a code for when I called back. I went online and bought $360 in gift cards, called them back and read him the numbers.</p>
<p> </p>
<p>I waited for the ticket confirmation email but nothing happened. I called the number back, and the rep said they had no record of my purchase and hung up.</p>
<p> </p>
<p>When I checked the website address carefully, I realized it was one letter different than the real site. This site and the 800 number I’d called were completely fake. I had given him the gift card numbers, so I had no recourse and my money was gone.</p>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>I wish I’d known:</strong></p>
<p> </p>
<ul>
<li>If you’re asked to pay using gift cards, it’s very likely a scam.</li>
<li>Being redirected to an “assistance line” after a “payment problem” is when I should have paused and been more suspicious.</li>
<li>I shouldn’t have let my desperation get the better of me, especially when I thought I was going to lose out on the tickets.</li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
</div><div class="StructuredText__SectionPadding-sc-g71ha1-3 iRNkXm"></div></div></div><div class="mds-pr-0 mds-row mds-no-gutters"></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></section></section></div></div></div><div class="mds-container"><hr/></div></div><div class="ProductTabs__HorizontalTabMobile-sc-ojzggy-1 gMchCu"></div><div data-feature="padding" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__PrimaryBackground-sc-o56u0b-2 fuhlfO bzLCuV Background__BackgroundWithBorderRadius-sc-o56u0b-0 Padding__RoundedBackgroundWithPadding-sc-nyctkn-0 fOzJIO"></div></div></div></div><div data-feature="padding" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__SecondaryBackground-sc-o56u0b-3 fuhlfO jGqcGv Background__BackgroundWithBorderRadius-sc-o56u0b-0 Padding__RoundedBackgroundWithPadding-sc-nyctkn-0 eNniuV"></div></div></div></div><div class="WithSectionIdentifier__StyledSectionIdentifierDiv-sc-w1dr2r-0 hKRxwV w-100 h-100" data-testid="section-mapping" id="check-fraud-basic-text" tabindex="-1"><div data-feature="basic-text" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__SecondaryBackground-sc-o56u0b-3 fuhlfO jGqcGv Background__BackgroundWithBorderRadius-sc-o56u0b-0"><div class="BasicText__MainContainer-sc-t3agr1-1 knhfJf mds-jc-center mds-no-gutters mds-row"><div class="mds-text-break mds-col mds-col-at-768-10 mds-px-4 mds-px-at-768-0"><div class="BasicText__DropCap-sc-t3agr1-0"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 boMkaX"><p> </p>
<h2 style="text-align: center;"><span class="mds-title-xlarge-heavier">Scam alert: Check fraud</span></h2>
<p> </p>
<p style="text-align: center;">Be careful when writing or depositing checks</p>
</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div data-feature="padding" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__SecondaryBackground-sc-o56u0b-3 fuhlfO jGqcGv Background__BackgroundWithBorderRadius-sc-o56u0b-0 Padding__RoundedBackgroundWithPadding-sc-nyctkn-0 eNniuV"></div></div></div></div><div class="WithSectionIdentifier__StyledSectionIdentifierDiv-sc-w1dr2r-0 hKRxwV w-100 h-100" data-testid="section-mapping" id="checks-you-write" tabindex="-1"><div data-feature="basic-text" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__PrimaryBackground-sc-o56u0b-2 fuhlfO bzLCuV Background__BackgroundWithBorderRadius-sc-o56u0b-0"><div class="BasicText__MainContainer-sc-t3agr1-1 knhfJf mds-jc-center mds-no-gutters mds-row"><div class="mds-text-break mds-col mds-col-at-768-10 mds-px-4 mds-px-at-768-0"><div class="BasicText__DropCap-sc-t3agr1-0"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 boMkaX"><p> </p>
<h3 style="text-align: left;"><span class="mds-title-xlarge-heavier">Checks you write</span></h3>
<p style="text-align: left;">Scammers can steal checks from mailboxes or ones not properly destroyed after being deposited. They can then use chemicals to erase and rewrite the check to themselves. They also may sell your personal information like name, address or account number, or use it to create counterfeit checks.</p>
</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="WithSectionIdentifier__StyledSectionIdentifierDiv-sc-w1dr2r-0 hKRxwV w-100 h-100" data-testid="section-mapping" id="check-writing-scams" tabindex="-1"><div data-feature="structured-text" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__PrimaryBackground-sc-o56u0b-2 fuhlfO bzLCuV"><div class="mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="StructuredText__ImagePosition-sc-g71ha1-7 ctwurL"></div></div></div><div class="mds-jc-center mds-pb-6 mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-col-12 mds-col-at-992-6"><div class="mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-col"><div class="StructuredText__TitleWrapper-sc-g71ha1-2 gOoBnv"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 gdoRDP"><h3><span class="mds-title-xlarge-heavier">How it can happen:</span></h3>
</div></div><div class="StructuredText__CrossPromoImagePadding-sc-g71ha1-6 kLzFFG"><div class="StructuredText__CrossPromoMediaInnerWrapper-sc-g71ha1-5 iYoLPP"><picture class="ImageWithSources__StyledPicture-sc-rc01gv-0 hIeuvF"><source srcSet="/content/dam/chase-ux/structured-text/personal/privacy-security/check-writing-scams-2.png" media=""/><img src="/content/dam/chase-ux/structured-text/personal/privacy-security/check-writing-scams-2.png" alt="" loading="eager" class="Image__Img-sc-qsmt06-0 hGVAqr mds-va-bottom w-100"/></picture></div></div></div></div></div><div class="mds-col-12 mds-col-at-992-6"><div class="mds-px-4 mds-px-at-768-5 mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="StructuredText__ColumnWithBorder-sc-g71ha1-0 dxHbJB mds-pl-5"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 gdoRDP"><h4><p><strong></strong><img src="/content/dam/unified-assets/illustration/chase-spot-illustrations/communication-chat-bubble/mds_ill_communication_chat_bubble_linear.svg" alt="a chat on check writing scams"> <span class="mds-title-large-heavier">I dropped a check in the mail and it set off a chain of events</span></p>
</h4>
<p> </p>
<p>I’ve always written checks and dropped them into the blue mail box on the corner. I thought it was safe.</p>
<p> </p>
<p>But one morning, my life was turned upside down. A bill that I knew I’d paid showed up as overdue. I checked my bank account and my heart skipped a beat. The check I’d mailed had been cashed for a much higher amount. Apparently, scammers had erased it and rewritten it for thousands more in their own name.</p>
<p> </p>
<p>My bill wasn’t paid and to make matters worse, scammers drained my account by cashing fake checks they’d created.</p>
<p> </p>
<h4>I wish I’d known:</h4>
<ul>
<li>I could use Chase Online℠ Bill Pay, which allows me to securely pay bills without sharing my account details.</li>
<li>Stolen checks can be washed, rewritten and replicated within hours.</li>
<li>Mail theft from blue boxes is far more common than people realize. If I ever mail checks again, I’ll send them from inside the post office.</li>
</ul>
</div><div class="StructuredText__SectionPadding-sc-g71ha1-3 iRNkXm"></div></div></div><div class="mds-pr-0 mds-row mds-no-gutters"></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div data-feature="padding" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__PrimaryBackground-sc-o56u0b-2 fuhlfO bzLCuV Background__BackgroundWithBorderRadius-sc-o56u0b-0 Padding__RoundedBackgroundWithPadding-sc-nyctkn-0 fOzJIO"></div></div></div></div><div class="WithSectionIdentifier__StyledSectionIdentifierDiv-sc-w1dr2r-0 hKRxwV w-100 h-100" data-testid="section-mapping" id="follow-check-writing-tips" tabindex="-1"><div data-feature="media-block-v2"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__PrimaryBackground-sc-o56u0b-2 fuhlfO bzLCuV"><div class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__PrimaryBackground-sc-o56u0b-2 fuhlfO bzLCuV"><div class="mds-fd-row  mds-d-flex mds-fw-wrap"><div class="mds-px-4 mds-px-at-768-0 mds-pl-at-768-4 mds-col-12 mds-col-at-768-6 mds-col-at-1200-7 mds-d-flex mds-fd-column mds-jc-center mds-px-0 mds-pt-5 mds-pt-at-768-0"><div class="mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 boMkaX MediaBlockV2__StyledText-sc-1mbs9wb-0 djZvUU mds-pt-2 mds-pt-at-768-3"><h3 style="text-align: left;"><span class="mds-title-xlarge-heavier">If you need to write checks, follow these tips</span></h3>
<p> </p>
<p style="text-align: left;"><strong></strong><img src="/content/dam/unified-assets/illustration/chase-illustrations/privacy-security/number_1.png" alt="a label with the number 1"> Use permanent ink so it's harder to erase.</p>
<p style="text-align: left;"> </p>
<p style="text-align: left;"><strong></strong><img src="/content/dam/unified-assets/illustration/chase-illustrations/privacy-security/number_2.png" alt="a label with the number 2"> Don't leave empty space before the payee or dollar amount.</p>
<p style="text-align: left;"> </p>
<p style="text-align: left;"><strong></strong><img src="/content/dam/unified-assets/illustration/chase-illustrations/privacy-security/number_3.png" alt="a label with the number 3"> Draw a line through the extra spaces.</p>
<p style="text-align: left;"> </p>
<p style="text-align: left;"><strong></strong><img src="/content/dam/unified-assets/illustration/chase-illustrations/privacy-security/number_4.png" alt="a label with the number 4"> Sign the same way every time.</p>
</div></div></div><div class="MediaBlockV2__ImageContainer-sc-1mbs9wb-3 imiQDT mds-d-flex mds-col-12 mds-col-at-768-6 mds-col-at-1200-5 mds-px-0"><img src="/content/dam/chase-ux/media-block-v2/digital/resources/privacy-security/follow-check-writing-tips.png" alt="an check example with four labeled parts on ways to avoid check fraud" loading="eager" class="Image__Img-sc-qsmt06-0 hGVAqr mds-d-flex mds-as-flex-start"/></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div data-feature="promo-breaker" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-overflow-hidden mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__PrimaryBackground-sc-o56u0b-2 fuhlfO bzLCuV Background__BackgroundWithBorderRadius-sc-o56u0b-0"><div class="PromoBreaker__PromoBreakerContainer-sc-6nkjsu-1 kaQNdG"><div class="mds-px-4 mds-px-at-768-5 mds-px-at-992-0 mds-fd-row-reverse mds-fd-at-992-row mds-fd-column-reverse mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-offset-at-992-1 mds-d-flex mds-fd-column mds-col-12 mds-col-at-992-9"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 gdoRDP"><h3><img src="/content/dam/unified-assets/illustration/chase-masterbrand/spot/featured/mds_ill_light_bulb_featured.svg" alt> Tips:</h3>
<ul>
<li>Mail checks from inside the post office.</li>
<li>Keep documents safe.</li>
<li>Review statements regularly.</li>
<li>Monitor your accounts and verify the payee and check amounts.</li>
<li>Consider alternative payment methods like <a class="chaseanalytics-track-link regular-link" data-pt-name="privacy_lnk_bill" href="/digital/online-bill-pay">Chase Online℠ Bill Pay</a>, <a class="chaseanalytics-track-link regular-link" data-pt-name="privacy_lnk_zelle1" href="/personal/zelle">Zelle<sup>®</sup></a>, or <a class="chaseanalytics-track-link regular-link" data-pt-name="privacy_lnk_debit" href="/personal/secure-banking/debit">your Chase debit card</a>.</li>
</ul>
</div></div></div><div class="mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-px-4 mds-px-at-768-5 mds-px-at-992-0 mds-offset-at-992-1 mds-col-12"><div class="mds-d-flex mds-fw-wrap mds-fd-column mds-fd-at-576-row mds-d-grid mds-ai-start mds-p-0"></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div data-feature="padding" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__NeutralBackground-sc-o56u0b-4 fuhlfO ddsMYX Background__BackgroundWithBorderRadius-sc-o56u0b-0 Padding__RoundedBackgroundWithPadding-sc-nyctkn-0 fOzJIO"></div></div></div></div><div class="WithSectionIdentifier__StyledSectionIdentifierDiv-sc-w1dr2r-0 hKRxwV w-100 h-100" data-testid="section-mapping" id="checks-you-deposit" tabindex="-1"><div data-feature="basic-text" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__NeutralBackground-sc-o56u0b-4 fuhlfO ddsMYX Background__BackgroundWithBorderRadius-sc-o56u0b-0"><div class="BasicText__MainContainer-sc-t3agr1-1 knhfJf mds-jc-center mds-no-gutters mds-row"><div class="mds-text-break mds-col mds-col-at-768-10 mds-px-4 mds-px-at-768-0"><div class="BasicText__DropCap-sc-t3agr1-0"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 boMkaX"><p> </p>
<h2 style="text-align: left;"><span class="mds-title-xlarge-heavier">Checks you deposit</span></h2>
<p> </p>
<p style="text-align: left;">Fake or stolen checks are often used in scams where someone might try to trick you into cashing or depositing the check. After you’ve deposited it, they might ask you to send some or all of the money back to them. This usually happens before the bank has a chance to process the check and discover that it’s not real — which can take weeks.</p>
</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div data-feature="padding" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__NeutralBackground-sc-o56u0b-4 fuhlfO ddsMYX Background__BackgroundWithBorderRadius-sc-o56u0b-0 Padding__RoundedBackgroundWithPadding-sc-nyctkn-0 fOzJIO"></div></div></div></div><div class="WithSectionIdentifier__StyledSectionIdentifierDiv-sc-w1dr2r-0 hKRxwV w-100 h-100" data-testid="section-mapping" id="be-on-alert" tabindex="-1"><div data-feature="featured-block" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__NeutralBackground-sc-o56u0b-4 fuhlfO ddsMYX Background__BackgroundWithBorderRadius-sc-o56u0b-0"><div class="mds-jc-center mds-px-4 mds-px-at-768-0 mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-col-12 mds-col-at-768-10"><div class="FeatureBlock__GridColumnFlex-sc-148aefy-1 jhbARN mds-fw-wrap mds-fw-at-992-nowrap"><div class="FeatureBlock__GridColumnNoPad-sc-148aefy-2 cgAfar mds-col-at-992-4 mds-col-12 mds-py-4 mds-jc-start"><div class="FeatureBlock__TitleStyle-sc-148aefy-4 iueVFN"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 gdoRDP"><h3><span class="mds-title-xlarge">Be on alert for check deposit scams like these</span></h3>
</div></div></div><div class="FeatureBlock__GridColumnNoPad-sc-148aefy-2 cgAfar mds-col-at-992-10 mds-col-at-576-12"><div class="mds-fw-at-768-wrap mds-py-4 mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="FeatureBlock__ColumnWithBorder-sc-148aefy-0 fFqbHf mds-d-flex mds-fd-column mds-px-0 mds-mr-at-768-5 mds-pl-5 mds-col-at-768-5 mds-col-12 mds-col-at-768-3"><div class="mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-d-flex mds-fd-column mds-col"><div class="FlexOrder-sc-e2j3f3-0 FeatureBlock__StyledFlexOrder-sc-148aefy-3 bNpNlB gEvkdD"><div class="mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 gdoRDP mds-text-break w-100"><h4>The Fake Job Scam</h4>
</div></div></div><div class="FlexOrder-sc-e2j3f3-0 gHEAA-D"><img src="/content/dam/unified-assets/illustration/chase-masterbrand/spot/featured/mds_ill_application_accept_featured_circle.svg" alt="" loading="eager" class="Image__Img-sc-qsmt06-0 hGVAqr FeatureBlock__ImageAspectRatio-sc-148aefy-7"/></div><div class="FlexOrder-sc-e2j3f3-0 knjYbS"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 boMkaX"><p> </p>
<p>Scammers post fake job ads online, send you a “paycheck,” then claim they overpaid and ask you to return part of it. Later, your bank says the check was fake, leaving you out the money you sent plus the bounced check amount.</p>
</div></div></div></div></div><div class="FeatureBlock__ColumnWithBorder-sc-148aefy-0 fFqbHf mds-d-flex mds-fd-column mds-px-0 mds-mr-at-768-5 mds-pl-5 mds-col-at-768-5 mds-col-12 mds-col-at-768-3"><div class="mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-d-flex mds-fd-column mds-col"><div class="FlexOrder-sc-e2j3f3-0 FeatureBlock__StyledFlexOrder-sc-148aefy-3 bNpNlB gEvkdD"><div class="mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 gdoRDP mds-text-break w-100"><h4>The Mystery Shopper Scam</h4>
</div></div></div><div class="FlexOrder-sc-e2j3f3-0 gHEAA-D"><img src="/content/dam/unified-assets/illustration/chase-masterbrand/spot/featured/mds_ill_gift_card_featured_circle.svg" alt="" loading="eager" class="Image__Img-sc-qsmt06-0 hGVAqr FeatureBlock__ImageAspectRatio-sc-148aefy-7"/></div><div class="FlexOrder-sc-e2j3f3-0 knjYbS"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 boMkaX"><p> </p>
<p>Scammers pretend to hire you as a mystery shopper and send you a check to buy gift cards. They claim they need the gift card numbers for record-keeping, but then use the cards themselves. When their check bounces, you’re left paying for the gift cards out of your own pocket.</p>
</div></div></div></div></div><div class="FeatureBlock__ColumnWithBorder-sc-148aefy-0 iaLkos mds-d-flex mds-fd-column mds-px-0 mds-mr-at-768-5 mds-pl-5 mds-col-at-768-5 mds-col-12 mds-col-at-768-3"><div class="mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-d-flex mds-fd-column mds-col"><div class="FlexOrder-sc-e2j3f3-0 FeatureBlock__StyledFlexOrder-sc-148aefy-3 bNpNlB gEvkdD"><div class="mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 gdoRDP mds-text-break w-100"><h4>The Overpayment Scam</h4>
</div></div></div><div class="FlexOrder-sc-e2j3f3-0 gHEAA-D"><img src="/content/dam/unified-assets/illustration/chase-masterbrand/spot/featured/mds_ill_money_featured_circle.svg" alt="" loading="eager" class="Image__Img-sc-qsmt06-0 hGVAqr FeatureBlock__ImageAspectRatio-sc-148aefy-7"/></div><div class="FlexOrder-sc-e2j3f3-0 knjYbS"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 boMkaX"><p> </p>
<p>A buyer “accidentally” overpays, asks you to refund the extra, then the original check bounces. You lose both the item and the money you sent back.</p>
</div></div></div></div></div><div class="FeatureBlock__ColumnWithBorder-sc-148aefy-0 iaLkos mds-d-flex mds-fd-column mds-px-0 mds-mr-at-768-5 mds-pl-5 mds-col-at-768-5 mds-col-12 mds-col-at-768-3"><div class="mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-d-flex mds-fd-column mds-col"><div class="FlexOrder-sc-e2j3f3-0 FeatureBlock__StyledFlexOrder-sc-148aefy-3 bNpNlB gEvkdD"><div class="mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 gdoRDP mds-text-break w-100"><h4>The Lottery / Sweepstakes Scam</h4>
</div></div></div><div class="FlexOrder-sc-e2j3f3-0 gHEAA-D"><img src="/content/dam/unified-assets/illustration/chase-masterbrand/spot/featured/mds_ill_trophy_featured_circle.svg" alt="" loading="eager" class="Image__Img-sc-qsmt06-0 hGVAqr FeatureBlock__ImageAspectRatio-sc-148aefy-7"/></div><div class="FlexOrder-sc-e2j3f3-0 knjYbS"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 boMkaX"><p> </p>
<p>You’re told you’ve won a prize and receive a fake check. Scammers then ask for “fees” or “taxes.” By the time you find out the check bounces, they already have your money.</p>
</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div data-feature="promo-breaker" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-overflow-hidden mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__NeutralBackground-sc-o56u0b-4 fuhlfO ddsMYX Background__BackgroundWithBorderRadius-sc-o56u0b-0"><div class="PromoBreaker__PromoBreakerContainer-sc-6nkjsu-1 kaQNdG"><div class="mds-px-4 mds-px-at-768-5 mds-px-at-992-0 mds-fd-row-reverse mds-fd-at-992-row mds-fd-column-reverse mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-offset-at-992-1 mds-d-flex mds-fd-column mds-col-12 mds-col-at-992-9"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 gdoRDP"><h3><img src="/content/dam/unified-assets/illustration/chase-masterbrand/spot/featured/mds_ill_light_bulb_featured.svg" alt> Tips:</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Don’t use the funds immediately,</strong> especially if the check is from someone you don’t know. It can take weeks for a bank to identify that the check was fake or if there were insufficient funds in the account to cover it.</li>
<li><strong>Be aware that fake checks can look very real. </strong>Scammers use advanced technology to produce counterfeit checks that closely resemble authentic ones.</li>
<li><strong>Be extra alert if someone claims to have overpaid.</strong> Scammers issue checks for a higher amount to trick you into returning the extra money.</li>
<li><strong>Ask to be paid with digital payments instead of checks.</strong> Consider convenient, fast and secure options like <a class="chaseanalytics-track-link regular-link" data-pt-name="privacy_lnk_pay" href="/digital/online-bill-pay">Chase Online℠ Bill Pay</a> or <a class="chaseanalytics-track-link regular-link" data-accessible-text="for online payment options" data-pt-name="privacy_lnk_zelle2" href="/personal/zelle">Zelle<sup>®</sup></a>.</li>
</ul>
</div></div></div><div class="mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-px-4 mds-px-at-768-5 mds-px-at-992-0 mds-offset-at-992-1 mds-col-12"><div class="mds-d-flex mds-fw-wrap mds-fd-column mds-fd-at-576-row mds-d-grid mds-ai-start mds-p-0"></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div data-feature="padding" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__SecondaryBackground-sc-o56u0b-3 fuhlfO jGqcGv Background__BackgroundWithBorderRadius-sc-o56u0b-0 Padding__RoundedBackgroundWithPadding-sc-nyctkn-0 eNniuV"></div></div></div></div><div class="WithSectionIdentifier__StyledSectionIdentifierDiv-sc-w1dr2r-0 hKRxwV w-100 h-100" data-testid="section-mapping" id="giftcardscamalert" tabindex="-1"><div data-feature="basic-text" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__SecondaryBackground-sc-o56u0b-3 fuhlfO jGqcGv Background__BackgroundWithBorderRadius-sc-o56u0b-0"><div class="BasicText__MainContainer-sc-t3agr1-1 knhfJf mds-jc-center mds-no-gutters mds-row"><div class="mds-text-break mds-col mds-col-at-768-10 mds-px-4 mds-px-at-768-0"><div class="BasicText__DropCap-sc-t3agr1-0"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 boMkaX"><p> </p>
<h2 style="text-align: center;"><span class="mds-title-xlarge-heavier">Scam alert: Gift cards</span></h2>
<p> </p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><span class="mds-body-xlarge-heavier">If you’re told to pay with a gift card, stop and think, it might be a scam</span></p>
</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div data-feature="padding" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__SecondaryBackground-sc-o56u0b-3 fuhlfO jGqcGv Background__BackgroundWithBorderRadius-sc-o56u0b-0 Padding__RoundedBackgroundWithPadding-sc-nyctkn-0 eNniuV"></div></div></div></div><div data-feature="basic-text" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__NeutralBackground-sc-o56u0b-4 fuhlfO ddsMYX Background__BackgroundWithBorderRadius-sc-o56u0b-0"><div class="BasicText__MainContainer-sc-t3agr1-1 knhfJf mds-jc-center mds-no-gutters mds-row"><div class="mds-text-break mds-col mds-col-at-768-10 mds-px-4 mds-px-at-768-0"><div class="BasicText__DropCap-sc-t3agr1-0"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 boMkaX"><p> </p>
<p> </p>
<p style="text-align: left;">Anytime someone says you need to pay with a gift card, it’s most likely a scam. Be aware that if you buy gift cards and give the scammer the gift card codes, it’s very unlikely you’ll get your money back.</p>
<p> </p>
<p style="text-align: left;"><strong>A common scam is the “Mystery Shopper Scam”</strong></p>
<p> </p>
<p style="text-align: left;">Scammers “hire” you as a mystery shopper and send you a check to cover your assignment. You’re told to buy gift cards and give them the numbers — but the check you deposited is fake, and they drain the cards. You’re left covering the cost.</p>
<p> </p>
<p> </p>
</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="WithSectionIdentifier__StyledSectionIdentifierDiv-sc-w1dr2r-0 hKRxwV w-100 h-100" data-testid="section-mapping" id="think-twice-gift-cards" tabindex="-1"><div data-feature="media-block-v2"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__PrimaryBackground-sc-o56u0b-2 fuhlfO bzLCuV"><div class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__NeutralBackground-sc-o56u0b-4 fuhlfO ddsMYX"><div class="mds-fd-row  mds-d-flex mds-fw-wrap"><div class="mds-px-4 mds-px-at-768-0 mds-pl-at-768-4 mds-col-12 mds-col-at-768-6 mds-col-at-1200-7 mds-d-flex mds-fd-column mds-jc-center mds-px-0 mds-pt-5 mds-pt-at-768-0"><div class="mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 boMkaX MediaBlockV2__StyledText-sc-1mbs9wb-0 djZvUU mds-pt-2 mds-pt-at-768-3"><h3 style="text-align: left;"><span class="mds-title-large">Think twice before choosing gift cards as a payment method:</span></h3>
<p> </p>
<p style="text-align: left;"><strong></strong><img src="/content/dam/unified-assets/illustration/chase-illustrations/privacy-security/number_1.png" alt="a label with the number 1">  <strong>Do not</strong> buy gift cards for anyone who asks for them through phone, text, or email, especially if they're threatening you. It's most likely a scam.</p>
<p style="text-align: left;"> </p>
<p style="text-align: left;"><strong></strong><img src="/content/dam/unified-assets/illustration/chase-illustrations/privacy-security/number_2.png" alt="a label with the number 2">  <strong>Do not</strong> give the gift card number or the 3 or 4 digit security code under the scratch off section to anyone.</p>
<p style="text-align: left;"> </p>
<p style="text-align: left;"><strong></strong><img src="/content/dam/unified-assets/illustration/chase-illustrations/privacy-security/number_3.png" alt="a label with the number 3"> <strong>Do not</strong> send a picture of the gift card number or security code to anyone.</p>
</div></div></div><div class="MediaBlockV2__ImageContainer-sc-1mbs9wb-3 imiQDT mds-d-flex mds-col-12 mds-col-at-768-6 mds-col-at-1200-5 mds-px-0"><img src="/content/dam/chase-ux/media-block-v2/digital/resources/privacy-security/gift-cards.png" alt="an gift card example with three labeled parts on ways to avoid gift card scams" loading="eager" class="Image__Img-sc-qsmt06-0 hGVAqr mds-d-flex mds-as-flex-start"/></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div data-feature="promo-breaker" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-overflow-hidden mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__NeutralBackground-sc-o56u0b-4 fuhlfO ddsMYX Background__BackgroundWithBorderRadius-sc-o56u0b-0"><div class="PromoBreaker__PromoBreakerContainer-sc-6nkjsu-1 kaQNdG"><div class="mds-px-4 mds-px-at-768-5 mds-px-at-992-0 mds-fd-row-reverse mds-fd-at-992-row mds-fd-column-reverse mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-offset-at-992-1 mds-d-flex mds-fd-column mds-col-12 mds-col-at-992-9"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 gdoRDP"><p><img src="/content/dam/unified-assets/illustration/chase-masterbrand/spot/featured/mds_ill_light_bulb_featured.svg" alt> <strong>Tip:</strong> If you're asked to buy a gift card to pay for goods or services, it's a scam warning flag.</p>
</div></div></div><div class="mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-px-4 mds-px-at-768-5 mds-px-at-992-0 mds-offset-at-992-1 mds-col-12"><div class="mds-d-flex mds-fw-wrap mds-fd-column mds-fd-at-576-row mds-d-grid mds-ai-start mds-p-0"></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div data-feature="padding" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__PrimaryBackground-sc-o56u0b-2 fuhlfO bzLCuV Background__BackgroundWithBorderRadius-sc-o56u0b-0 Padding__RoundedBackgroundWithPadding-sc-nyctkn-0 fOzJIO"></div></div></div></div><div class="WithSectionIdentifier__StyledSectionIdentifierDiv-sc-w1dr2r-0 hKRxwV w-100 h-100" data-testid="section-mapping" id="watch-out-charity-scams-basic" tabindex="-1"><div data-feature="basic-text" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__PrimaryBackground-sc-o56u0b-2 fuhlfO bzLCuV Background__BackgroundWithBorderRadius-sc-o56u0b-0"><div class="BasicText__MainContainer-sc-t3agr1-1 knhfJf mds-jc-center mds-no-gutters mds-row"><div class="mds-text-break mds-col mds-col-at-768-10 mds-px-4 mds-px-at-768-0"><div class="BasicText__DropCap-sc-t3agr1-0"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 boMkaX"><p> </p>
<h2 style="text-align: center;"><span class="mds-title-xlarge-heavier">Watch out for charity scams</span></h2>
<p> </p>
</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="WithSectionIdentifier__StyledSectionIdentifierDiv-sc-w1dr2r-0 hKRxwV w-100 h-100" data-testid="section-mapping" id="charity-scams" tabindex="-1"><div data-feature="media-block-v2"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__PrimaryBackground-sc-o56u0b-2 fuhlfO bzLCuV"><div class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__PrimaryBackground-sc-o56u0b-2 fuhlfO bzLCuV"><div class="mds-fd-row-reverse  mds-d-flex mds-fw-wrap"><div class="mds-px-4 mds-px-at-768-0 mds-pr-at-768-4 mds-col-12 mds-col-at-768-6 mds-col-at-1200-7 mds-d-flex mds-fd-column mds-jc-center mds-px-0 mds-pt-5 mds-pt-at-768-0"><div class="mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 boMkaX MediaBlockV2__StyledText-sc-1mbs9wb-0 gMjdYE mds-pt-2 mds-pt-at-768-3"><h3>What's happening?</h3>
<p><br>
Scammers come out of the woodwork to prey on people who are looking to help relief efforts when disaster strikes.</p>
<p> </p>
<p>Charity scams can appear as fraudulent websites, phishing emails, text messages, crowdfunding sites, phone calls, and postal mail. Being informed is key to protecting your donations. Tactics scammers use are:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Impersonation:</strong> They mimic established charities or create new ones with similar names</li>
<li><strong>Emotional appeals:</strong> They use heart-wrenching stories and pictures</li>
<li><strong>Technology:</strong> They create and share links to websites that look like they’re legitimate charities </li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Tips to help you stay safe:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Verify the charity:</strong> Check the legitimacy of the charity and access their official website through <a href="https://www.charitywatch.org/" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="chaseanalytics-opt-exlnk regular-link" data-pt-name="digital_lnk_charity">CharityWatch</a> or the <a href="https://give.org/" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="chaseanalytics-opt-exlnk regular-link" data-pt-name="digital_lnk_give">BBB Wise Giving Alliance</a></li>
<li><strong>Be cautious of unsolicited calls or texts:</strong> If a charity reaches out unexpectedly, say you'll call back using the number listed in the <a href="https://www.charitywatch.org/" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="chaseanalytics-opt-exlnk regular-link" data-accessible-text="for more information" data-pt-name="digital_lnk_watch">CharityWatch</a> or the <a href="https://give.org/" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="chaseanalytics-opt-exlnk regular-link" data-accessible-text="for giving options" data-pt-name="digital_lnk_bbb">BBB Wise Giving Alliance</a></li>
</ul>
</div></div></div><div class="MediaBlockV2__ImageContainer-sc-1mbs9wb-3 kdzNpo mds-d-flex mds-col-12 mds-col-at-768-6 mds-col-at-1200-5 mds-px-0"><img src="/content/dam/chase-ux/media-block-v2/digital/resources/privacy-security/charity-scams-765x765.png" alt="" loading="eager" class="Image__Img-sc-qsmt06-0 hGVAqr mds-d-flex mds-as-flex-start"/></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div data-feature="padding" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__PrimaryBackground-sc-o56u0b-2 fuhlfO bzLCuV Background__BackgroundWithBorderRadius-sc-o56u0b-0 Padding__RoundedBackgroundWithPadding-sc-nyctkn-0 fOzJIO"></div></div></div></div><div class="WithSectionIdentifier__StyledSectionIdentifierDiv-sc-w1dr2r-0 hKRxwV w-100 h-100" data-testid="section-mapping" id="scams-happen" tabindex="-1"><div data-feature="basic-text" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__PrimaryBackground-sc-o56u0b-2 fuhlfO bzLCuV Background__BackgroundWithBorderRadius-sc-o56u0b-0"><div class="BasicText__MainContainer-sc-t3agr1-1 knhfJf mds-jc-center mds-no-gutters mds-row"><div class="mds-text-break mds-col mds-col-at-768-10 mds-px-4 mds-px-at-768-0"><div class="BasicText__DropCap-sc-t3agr1-0"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 boMkaX"><h2 style="text-align: center;"><span class="mds-title-xlarge-heavier">Scams can happen to anyone</span></h2>
<p> </p>
</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="WithSectionIdentifier__StyledSectionIdentifierDiv-sc-w1dr2r-0 hKRxwV w-100 h-100" data-testid="section-mapping" id="student-scams-video" tabindex="-1"><div data-testid="SC.SpotScams_studentscams" data-module-name="SC.SpotScams_studentscams" data-module-visible="false" data-module-tracked="false" data-module-position="35"><div data-feature="media-block" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="mds-jc-center mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="mds-col-12 mds-col-at-768-10"><div class="MediaBlock__GridRowContainer-sc-a5jjz2-6 lbBPKk mds-d-grid h-100 mds-overflow-hidden mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__PrimaryBackground-sc-o56u0b-2 fuhlfO bzLCuV MediaBlock__BackgroundContainer-sc-a5jjz2-0 cuFJnU"></div><div class="MediaBlock__DescriptionContainer-sc-a5jjz2-2 iPkrPv"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 gdoRDP mds-pb-at-576-6_7 mds-pb-6"><h3>Watch how scammers are using technology to target younger people</h3>
<ul>
<li>Get helpful tips for how to protect yourself</li>
<li>See how tools from Chase can help safeguard your money</li>
</ul>
</div></div><div class="MediaBlock__MediaContainer-sc-a5jjz2-3 kXCdMk"><div class="MediaBlock__Media-sc-a5jjz2-4 cqzJQk"><div data-testid="video-module" class="VideoWithAnalytics__VideoContainer-sc-hw527q-0 fbZXSG video-container"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__PrimaryBackground-sc-o56u0b-2 fuhlfO bzLCuV"><div id="video" data-testid="video-module" class="Video__VideoContainer-sc-80c3qs-2 cijANI"><div class="chase-brightcove-video"></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div data-feature="padding" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__PrimaryBackground-sc-o56u0b-2 fuhlfO bzLCuV Background__BackgroundWithBorderRadius-sc-o56u0b-0 Padding__RoundedBackgroundWithPadding-sc-nyctkn-0 fOzJIO"></div></div></div></div><div data-feature="padding" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__SecondaryBackground-sc-o56u0b-3 fuhlfO jGqcGv Background__BackgroundWithBorderRadius-sc-o56u0b-0 Padding__RoundedBackgroundWithPadding-sc-nyctkn-0 eNniuV"></div></div></div></div><div class="WithSectionIdentifier__StyledSectionIdentifierDiv-sc-w1dr2r-0 hKRxwV w-100 h-100" data-testid="section-mapping" id="scammer-tricks" tabindex="-1"><div data-feature="basic-text" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__SecondaryBackground-sc-o56u0b-3 fuhlfO jGqcGv Background__BackgroundWithBorderRadius-sc-o56u0b-0"><div class="BasicText__MainContainer-sc-t3agr1-1 knhfJf mds-jc-center mds-no-gutters mds-row"><div class="mds-text-break mds-col mds-col-at-768-10 mds-px-4 mds-px-at-768-0"><div class="BasicText__DropCap-sc-t3agr1-0"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 boMkaX"><p> </p>
<h2 style="text-align: center;"><span class="mds-title-xlarge-heavier">Knowing about scammers' tricks can help you stay one step ahead of them</span></h2>
<p> </p>
<p style="text-align: center;">Here are some of the latest schemes to avoid:</p>
</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div data-feature="padding" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__SecondaryBackground-sc-o56u0b-3 fuhlfO jGqcGv Background__BackgroundWithBorderRadius-sc-o56u0b-0 Padding__RoundedBackgroundWithPadding-sc-nyctkn-0 eNniuV"></div></div></div></div><div data-feature="padding" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__PrimaryBackground-sc-o56u0b-2 fuhlfO bzLCuV Background__BackgroundWithBorderRadius-sc-o56u0b-0 Padding__RoundedBackgroundWithPadding-sc-nyctkn-0 eNniuV"></div></div></div></div><div class="WithSectionIdentifier__StyledSectionIdentifierDiv-sc-w1dr2r-0 hKRxwV w-100 h-100" data-testid="section-mapping" id="bankimpersonations" tabindex="-1"><div data-feature="media-block-v2"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__PrimaryBackground-sc-o56u0b-2 fuhlfO bzLCuV"><div class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__PrimaryBackground-sc-o56u0b-2 fuhlfO bzLCuV"><div class="mds-fd-row  mds-d-flex mds-fw-wrap"><div class="mds-px-4 mds-px-at-768-0 mds-pl-at-768-4 mds-col-12 mds-col-at-768-6 mds-col-at-1200-7 mds-d-flex mds-fd-column mds-jc-center mds-px-0 mds-pt-5 mds-pt-at-768-0"><div class="mds-row mds-no-gutters"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 boMkaX MediaBlockV2__StyledText-sc-1mbs9wb-0 djZvUU mds-pt-2 mds-pt-at-768-3"><h3>Watch out for scammers impersonating banks</h3>
<p> </p>
<h4>What's happening?</h4>
<p> </p>
<p>A scammer calls or texts pretending to be from Chase and says you need to send money to another account using a wire transfer. They may claim it’s to reverse fraud on your account. Don’t fall for it – it’s a scam!</p>
<p> </p>
<p>We will never ask you to send money to yourself.</p>
<p> </p>
<h4>Tips to help you stay safe:</h4>
<ul>
<li>Know who you're talking to: You can verify that you're speaking with us by hanging up and calling the number on the back of your Chase card or your account statement.</li>
<li>Take a moment: Think about what they're asking for, and verify they are who they say they are, especially if it feels urgent or pressured — it could be a scam.</li>
<li>Be careful when sending money: It's important to verify you're not sending money to a scammer. Once you send money you may not be able to get it back.</li>
</ul>

</div><span class="AccordionDrawer__IconWrapper-sc-1ovzhuy-3 zxOMr mds-pos-absolute mds-va-middle mds-right-0 mds-pr-5"><i class="MdsIcons__StyledIcon-sc-15dugwy-0 epOAUw mds-chase-icons mds-pe-none ico_chevron_down" style="padding:0.3125rem 0.9375rem 0.3125rem 0.3125rem;--icon-hover-color:var(--accordion-drawer-text-hover-color);--icon-color:var(--accordion-drawer-text-color)" aria-hidden="true"></i></span></div></span></button></h3></div><section id="spot-scams-faq_steal-identity-faq" class="w-100"><div role="region" aria-labelledby="section_spot-scams-faq_steal-identity-faq" data-testid="spot-scams-faq_steal-identity-faq" id="accordion_spot-scams-faq_steal-identity-faq" class="AccordionDrawer__SectionContent-sc-1ovzhuy-0 eqwJID mds-d-none"><div class="WithSectionIdentifier__StyledSectionIdentifierDiv-sc-w1dr2r-0 hKRxwV w-100 h-100" data-testid="section-mapping" id="iraqi-dinar-faq" tabindex="-1"><div data-feature="basic-text" class="mds-container"><div class="mds-row"><div class="mds-col-12"><div class="Background__DefaultStyle-sc-o56u0b-1 Background__PrimaryBackground-sc-o56u0b-2 fuhlfO bzLCuV Background__BackgroundWithBorderRadius-sc-o56u0b-0"><div class="BasicText__MainContainer-sc-t3agr1-1 knhfJf mds-no-gutters mds-row"><div class="mds-text-break mds-col mds-col-at-768-10 mds-px-4 mds-px-at-768-0"><div class="BasicText__DropCap-sc-t3agr1-0"><div class="security__TextColor-sc-1pgztkc-0 boMkaX"><p>JP Morgan Chase (JPMC) does not buy, sell, or exchange Iraqi dinar (IQD) banknotes and currently has no plans to offer this service in the future. You may have read or have heard that Chase Bank buys, sells or exchanges this currency, this information is incorrect. You may have been also told that JPMC is opening branches and offices in Iraq to aid in the revaluation process, this information is also incorrect.</p>
<p> </p>
<p>We urge you to seek the advice of your professional investment advisor before making any investments. You should always consult with professionals prior to joining any investment schemes you may have heard about through the internet, and before you send any money to people claiming to facilitate the purchase of any foreign currencies.</p>
<p> </p>
